newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Commission clears Irish film board loans.
newsitem.headline: Commission clears Irish film board loans.

text.p: The European Commission said on Wednesday it was not opposing aid granted in the form of interest-free loans by the Irish Film Board for the production of television documentaries and feature-length fiction films.

The Commission said in a statement the production loans, which amount to 149,887 punts of the production budget of a film, were repayable at least to the extent that the film generates sufficient resources.
The Commission statement said the board also acquired an equity return where a film is particularly successful.

"Given that the scheme pursues cultural objectives, in that the aided projects contain an Irish cultural/artistic merit, the Commission approved the scheme on the basis of Article 92(3)(d) of the EC Treaty," the Commission said in a statement.
